env.buildCommand:
export HOME=$TMPDIR/home
mkdir -p "$HOME" "$out"
cp -r /nix/store/l8a3z1rq0g0wr4hmax37syqmp8sfk05v-source $TMPDIR/gson
chmod -R u+w $TMPDIR/gson
cd $TMPDIR/gson
/nix/store/pn2jm93hh9gpc8x38phfbsm7f115njr2-maven-purifier-0.1.0/bin/maven-purifier prefetch \
  --lockfile /nix/store/i7pv6vf4aymkspcyrm5jcsvds1sl9m8q-maven-purifier.lock.json \
  --prefetched /nix/store/1wf15rz90y4i4hw052j463mv895xxpmx-maven-purifier-prefetch
export JAVA_HOME=$PWD/.maven-purifier/jdk
export PATH=$PWD/.maven-purifier/bin:$PATH
mvn --version > "$out/toolchain.txt"
mvn -B -ntp clean install > "$out/maven.log" 2>&1
python3 /nix/store/7fzhhxf6d3lsv4mslhqcmj0rn6wrck1r-check-reports.py . | tee "$out/tests.txt"
junit=.maven-purifier/repository/junit/junit/4.13.2/junit-4.13.2.jar
test -f "$junit"
mv "$junit" $TMPDIR/withheld-junit.jar
if mvn -B -ntp -pl gson test > "$out/missing-artifact.log" 2>&1; then
  echo 'Maven accepted a missing locked test dependency' >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -i 'offline' "$out/missing-artifact.log"
grep 'junit:junit' "$out/missing-artifact.log"
env.name: maven-purifier-gson-offline

env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
export HOME="$TMPDIR/home"
export JAVA_HOME=/nix/store/xr0h7rmm6a91nnsrsyp9xa5wnsb9qh70-zulu-ca-jdk-21.0.11
mkdir -p "$HOME"
cp -r --no-preserve=mode /nix/store/78ng7iz0xzap2x2vmjxwilyvxzaj937p-maven-repository/. "$TMPDIR/repository"
# The lines `maven-purifier prefetch` writes into .mvn/maven.config
# point at files of the machine that ran it.
if [ -f .mvn/maven.config ]; then
  sed -i '/^-Dmaven-purifier.prefetched=true$/,$d' .mvn/maven.config
fi

cp -r --no-preserve=mode /nix/store/z4b7mr16rmnfpvrjgr41nb6vdzdb7zba-maven-runtime-recorder/. "$TMPDIR/repository"
export MAVEN_PURIFIER_RECORD="$TMPDIR/runtime-record.jsonl"
export MAVEN_PURIFIER_CAPTURE_RUNTIME=1
maven_failed() {
  echo "maven-purifier: Maven failed offline. If it reports an artifact that has not been downloaded, the lock does not hold everything this build needs: run \`maven-purifier lock --force\` at the build root, with the goals and -P options you build with. If it reports a compile or test failure, the build itself failed." >&2
  exit 1
}
/nix/store/z461v33n2bb5dp4fbnwbx1ipmlxdxdz7-maven-3.10.0/bin/mvn -o -B \
  -Dmaven.ext.class.path=/nix/store/3m5afh17gfl6qqrbxnaxdxbp443jigxq-maven-purifier-extension-0.1.0/share/java/maven-purifier-extension.jar -Dmaven-purifier.replay=true \
  -s /nix/store/iwhgnnm0liv73paq5ixzjk6z77b2iq88-settings.xml \
  -Dmaven.repo.local="$TMPDIR/repository" \
  -Duser.home="$HOME" \
  -Daether.remoteRepositoryFilter.prefixes=false \
  -Dproject.build.outputTimestamp=1980-01-01T00:00:02Z \
  clean install io.github.nix-purifiers:maven-purifier-legacy-recorder:1:record </dev/null || maven_failed

runHook postBuild
env.installPhase:
runHook preInstall
mkdir -p $out
find . -type d \( -name surefire-reports -o -name failsafe-reports \) -path '*/target/*' | while read -r reports; do
  mkdir -p "$out/$(dirname "$reports")"
  cp -r "$reports" "$out/$reports"
done
runHook postInstall
env.name: maven-tests
